assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent hand-drawn 2D JRPG overworld map illustration.
Subject: One complete compact miniature walled town, Mosswood: a charming clock hall with a short clock tower in the back center, a tiny central fountain plaza, nine varied cream and pale ochre houses around it, slate-blue and a few terracotta roofs, a blue-striped bakery awning and green market awning, little gardens and round trees. A low ivory stone wall encloses the whole settlement with one clearly open gateway at the BOTTOM CENTER, a very short approach path, and a small grassy planted foundation. Every rooftop and the full outer town silhouette visible together. Wide oval-ish layout, approximately 1.5 times wider than tall, a single cohesive city map illustration.
Style: a handcrafted gouache and watercolor ANIME BACKGROUND DRAWING, charming countryside fantasy picture-book art. Broad matte color washes, clearly visible loose brush marks, delicate warm ink-pencil contour lines, restrained simple shading, softly simplified painted details. Cream, sage, ochre and slate blue with tiny flower accents. Flat illustrative color shapes; NOT a photoreal model, NOT a 3D render, NOT glossy, NOT a miniature product photograph, NOT realistic stone/tile microtexture.
Camera: consistent elevated three-quarter near-orthographic view, around 30 degrees down; front and a little right side visible; straight structural verticals and level lintels, no leaning or skewing. Daylight is gentle and diffuse, no dramatic cast shadow.
Composition: one complete single cutout centered, generous transparent padding, entire silhouette uncut. Real transparent alpha surrounding the artwork, no sky, backdrop, large terrain tile, frame, text, watermark or other separate objects. Must read clearly as a small painted map symbol at 100–350 pixels.
